headline: Corgi Loaf Baking Co.: Preseason Front Office Brief
executive_summary: Corgi Loaf Baking Co. is projected #6 of 16 with a 634.30 projected-starting-lineup C-AVI total, led by Justin Jefferson, Tyler Warren, and Cam Skattebo. The immediate priority is improving the FLEX slot without weakening that core. On the Power Rankings webpage's D-AVI ladder, the franchise ranks #15 of 16 with a 0.0 team D-AVI score.

latest_trade.summary: On July 26, Corgi Loaf Baking Co. traded with Ravens Regime and acquired Tyler Warren, 2026 Round 1 (Ravens Regime), 2028 Round 1 (Ravens Regime) while sending Isaac TeSlaa, Kyle Pitts, 2026 Round 1 (Rapid Valley Annihilation). Tyler Warren is now the current TE starter at 97.2 C-AVI and 91.9 D-AVI; The deal sent out 1 draft asset, reducing future flexibility; The deal added 2 draft assets.
